benefit_text: The scheme provides apprenticeship training in Designated Trades for one year for ITI pass‑outs and two years for fresher or non‑ITI candidates, and in Optional Trades for six, nine or twelve months. The government pays 25% of the stipend, up to ₹1,500 per month, directly to the apprentice’s bank account. Minimum monthly stipend starts at ₹5,000 for school pass‑outs and goes up to ₹9,000 for graduate apprentices.
who_can_apply: Anyone aged 14 years or more can apply, and the upper age limit is 35 years. For designated trades in hazardous industries, the minimum age is 18 years. There is no income condition. Candidates must have an Aadhaar number and complete e‑KYC on the apprenticeship portal.
documents: Aadhaar Card. Documents required as per the selected trade.
how_to_apply: Visit the Apprenticeship Portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Click Login/Register and choose Candidate. Enter mobile number, email and Aadhaar to complete e‑KYC. Verify with OTP. After registration you can apply for the apprenticeship.
